title: Agile Roundtable - Virtual
description: Utah Agile Join us on Zoom for a virtual roundtable to explore how AI is impacting organizations and their agility. Bring your experiences, perspectives, questions, challenges, and answers if you have them to unpack with others what's happening with AI and how it's impacting the work we're doing.  **How do Agile Roundtables work?** At Agile Roundtables, participants co-create the agenda with the topics they want to discuss. A facilitator guides the team from topic to topic. Then each participant has an opportunity to share what they're taking away from the session. Simple, but powerful!  **Join us!** Agile Roundtables in Utah have been happening monthly since before the Agile Manifesto was written in 2001. Whether you've joined us many times or this is your first, please come! Bring your questions, your challenges, and ideas. You'll walk away from this session not only having gained, but also given something! Even if you don't have a topic in mind, come network, listen, and engage!
